description: Off-campus buildings the SCNU 360 VR tour shows that GIS건물통합정보 lacks or gives no storeys. `floors` gives storey counts (a use class for the storey median and wall tone, and optionally heightMetres with heightNote where the off-campus storey median does not fit, e.g. apartment towers) to footprint records of data/gis-buildings.json that carry none, matched by footprintSource prefix; `buildings` are footprints traced by eye on the NGII 2025 orthophoto where neither GIS nor OSM has one. Every value is estimated (추정). Applied by stages/sources.mjs (loadVrContextBuildings) after gis-buildings.json and vr-buildings.json; context masses only (stages/context.mjs), never BLD_ ids.
sources: SCNU 360 VR tour (visual reference only, nothing copied)
NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020 (footprints traced by eye, 0.25 m GSD)
© OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0): names and footprints of the matched OSM records
